settings.title: The career ceiling in general dentistry

settings.editor: For many general dental practitioners, career progression can eventually plateau. Your clinical lists are busy, but opportunities to significantly expand scope or income often require advanced training.

Traditionally, specialising in orthodontics has meant stepping away from practice for several years, losing income and navigating rigid university timetables.

For most practising dentists, these traditional pathways are simply not feasible.

Expanding your scope to include orthodontic treatments can enhance patient care while creating new opportunities within your practice — improving case acceptance, patient retention, and overall practice growth.

I would fully recommend the PG Diploma in Orthodontics from LDI. The course is in depth and comprehensive, but delivered in a way that is convenient and adaptable to existing clinical and family life. The course gives confidence in all aspects of orthodontics, and will take aligner treatments and workflows to another level completely.
General Dentist, UK

Even as an online programme it provided me with the best knowledge and experience to improve my practice in my clinic.
The Diploma gave me the proper knowledge and confidence to start incorporating more of these cases, and helped to improve my income by about 40%. Studying with LDI was one of the best decisions in my dental career.
General Dentist, Jordan
